construction: 27 parts in 12 steps. Steps 3–8: brackets (1×2–2×2 down, 1×2–1×4, 1×2–1×2 down and up). Step 4: two 1×4 plates with two studs. Step 7: two 1×3 plates with 2 studs offset, standing studs-forward. Step 9: child `219`. Step 11: child `221`, two grille slopes on a 1×3 offset plate, half-stud centred. Step 12: child `222`, a car mudguard as the arch over the vent.
interfaces: Stud directions: 27 parts, 17 −Z (forward), 9 up, 1 down. The parent uses the identity matrix.
lesson: Offset (jumper) plates centre a 2-wide grille on a face built forward; a car mudguard becomes the sculpted arch.
parent_context: The mouth vent under the face of the Stormtrooper helmet (`75276 - main.ldr`).
reuse_notes: Use offset plates whenever a feature must sit half a stud off the grid on a forward face.
